context_requirements: Endogenous androgen substrate for aromatase (e.g., testosterone/androstenedione)
Androgen receptor (AR) expression for downstream transcriptional consequences
Estrogen receptor (ER) expression for autocrine/paracrine estrogen signaling effects
falsifiers: Consistent, dose-dependent changes in AR- or ER-dependent landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any line
Reproducible upregulation of CYP19A1 itself or of estrogen-responsive genes across multiple lines
Any line showing a clear transcriptional signature that is reversed by adding estradiol or an AR agonist
